items.followUp: Write the truth table for the OR operator.

rubric.why: The table must show each possible combination of the two inputs.
rubric.description: Lists all four input combinations for A and B.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for including the rows 00, 01, 10 and 11.

rubric.why: For AND, the output is 1 only when both inputs are 1.
rubric.description: Gives the correct output for every input combination.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the output sequence 0, 0, 0, 1 in the corresponding rows.

items.followUp: What is the purpose of a patent law?

rubric.why: Copyright law protects creators’ rights over their work.
rubric.description: States that copyright law protects creators and their work.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying protection of creators or their work.

rubric.why: Copyright law restricts copying or use without permission.
rubric.description: Explains that the law prevents unauthorized copying or use.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning unauthorized copying, use or distribution.

modelAnswer: Copyright law protects the rights of creators over their original work.
It prevents others from copying, using or distributing that work without permission.

rubric.why: Data communication involves data being exchanged or transmitted.
rubric.description: States that data or information is exchanged or transmitted.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning data or information being exchanged, transmitted or transferred.

rubric.why: Data communication takes place between devices through a medium or network.
rubric.description: Identifies the communicating devices and their connection or medium.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for referring to devices communicating through a medium or network.

modelAnswer: Data communication is the exchange or transmission of data between two or more devices.
The devices communicate through a communication medium or network.

items.followUp: Give two examples of hardware that can be shared on a network.

rubric.why: Hardware sharing makes hardware resources available to network users.
rubric.description: Defines hardware sharing as sharing hardware resources among users.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that users share hardware resources, preferably in a network context.

rubric.why: A valid example identifies hardware that users can share.
rubric.description: Gives at least one example of shared hardware.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for an example such as a printer, storage device or scanner.

modelAnswer: Hardware sharing means making hardware resources available for use by different users on a network.
For example, network users can share a printer or a storage device.

items.followUp: What is an ordered list in HTML?

rubric.why: A definition list contains terms or items to be defined.
rubric.description: Identifies the entries in a definition list as terms or items.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a definition list contains terms, words or items.

rubric.why: Each term is accompanied by its definition or description.
rubric.description: States that the list gives definitions or descriptions of its terms.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning definitions, descriptions or explanations.

modelAnswer: A definition list is an HTML list used to display terms and their definitions or descriptions.
It uses the <dl> tag for the list, <dt> for a term and <dd> for its definition.
